description: X25519-ECIES + HKDF-SHA-256 + AES-KW-256 unwrap (CONTRACT_SPEC.md §6.3): a fixed 76-byte reference wrap envelope unwraps to the 32-byte DEK under the recipient's X25519 private key. The conformance direction is UNWRAP — forward wrapping is non-deterministic (a fresh ephemeral key per §6.3 step 1), so every conformant implementation MUST unwrap this reference envelope to the same DEK.
notes: Bootstrap artifact: the wrap envelope was produced once by the reference Go implementation (internal/envelope/WrapDEK) with a random ephemeral per CS §6.3 step 1 and pinned here per CS §17.4. The envelope is self-contained — bytes 4..35 are the ephemeral public key — so UnwrapDEK is fully deterministic on (envelope, recipient_private_key). Envelope layout: magic CEDE + version 01 + wrap_alg 01 + ephemeral_pub[32] + wrapped_dek[40].

description: CONTRACT_SPEC.md §8.2 POST /v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/wrapped-deks request + 200 response shape. wrapped_by_member_id MUST equal the authenticated session-actor's member_id (Q-G6-33 handler-level identity binding). SHAPE vector (no crypto oracle) — independently cross-verified at Groups 12/13 per §17.4.
notes: audit_entry_id is NOT in the response body per Q-G6-10 wire-faithfulness.

description: CONTRACT_SPEC.md §8.3 GET /v1/members/{member_id}/wrapped-deks happy path: a member with one active wrapped DEK at the current tenant DEK version. SHAPE vector.
CONTRACT_SPEC.md §8.3: a member that exists but has no active wrapped DEK returns 200 with an empty array (awaiting wrapping by an existing member). SHAPE vector.
CONTRACT_SPEC.md §8.4 POST /v1/wrapped-deks/{wrapped_dek_id}/revoke request + 200 response shape. reason MUST be one of the three enumerated values. SHAPE vector.
notes: A revoked wrapped DEK is retained for audit (UPDATE revoked_at, no DELETE) per CS §8.4.

description: CONTRACT_SPEC.md §8.1 POST /v1/members/{member_id}/public-key request + 200 response shape. Carries the 32-byte X25519 public key + SHA-256 of the auth_verification_token (§5.4) + the public-key fingerprint. SHAPE vector.
notes: public_key_version increments on each call (first registration -> 1; §5.6 password-change re-upload -> 2, 3, ...).
